comments.text: My 03 Chevy Trailblazer has been in the shop once in the past year, and that was for inspection. It passed and didn't need anything lol. Always buy older cars. Know what else I have. Keys!! No stupid card, no fob to go dead. Just simple keys. Put the key in the door, turn it, and it opens. Put the key in the ignition, turn it, and it starts. Simple. Want to turn off the airflow? Turn the knob. That's it. No touchscreens, no computerized bullshit. Just simple knobs and switches. Does anyone seriously need all that crap in a car?  Sure, they think they're getting convenience and luxury, but all they're getting is more shit to go wrong. So while their expensive shiny new cars are sitting in the shop for the 11th time in 2 months, I'm still out there doing my thing with no issues. And if something does break on mine, I can just go to my awesome mechanic, and he can fix it or replace the very simple parts. I don't need a technician and an entire IT department. He actually gets pretty excited when I call him and need something fixed (I have 4 old cars; the 03 is the "newest" one) because he knows it's going to be a strictly mechanical, easy fix, and he won't have to research a bunch of computer crap to get it done.
